entities.summary: Offa, a notable figure in the history of United Kingdom, associated with Anglo-Saxon Settlement and Kingdoms (626–796). Preceded by Mercian Supremacy and Synod of Whitby 664. Their legacy influenced Northumbrian Golden Age.
